archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Soft SaaS Gradients

fonts.heading: Outfit
fonts.instructions: Use Outfit for all headings with tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for larger sizes. Use Manrope for clean, highly legible body text. Do not use Inter for headings.

colors.instructions: Rely heavily on white space. Gradients should be used as subtle background glows (e.g. absolute positioned blur-3xl divs) or text clips, rather than heavy solid blocks.

spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous padding. Sections should have py-24 or py-32.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-3xl for major cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Use soft diffuse shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards.
spacing_and_layout.hero: Centered layout. Large H1 text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter. Subheadline text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-500 max-w-2xl mx-auto.
spacing_and_layout.features_bento: Use CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1 to create an asymmetrical bento box layout.

components.navigation: Sticky, crystal glassmorphism header. Text logo 'EaseTalk' in font-bold text-xl tracking-tight. CTA 'Get Early Access' in navigation.
components.hero_section: Text-heavy top, glowing background blobs (blue and purple blur-3xl). Below the CTA, place a floating UI Phone Mockup using framer-motion.
components.smart_apps_section: Three equal cards. Each card has a subtle gradient icon container, large heading, and soft text. Hover effect: translate-y-[-4px] and shadow-lg.
components.why_easetalk_section: Bento grid of 4 blocks. Use imagery for at least one block to humanize the tech.
components.innovation_section: Dark inverted section or a heavily gradient glowing border card. E.g. bg-slate-900 text-white with a 'Tracing Beam' or glowing purple/blue edge to represent 'Emergent Agent AI'.
components.contact_card: A clean, centered Neumorphic or Glass card. Minimal form inputs (Shadcn UI customized).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons should have a slight scale (active:scale-95) and color shift.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion to fade in and slightly slide up (y: 20 -> 0) major sections on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.mockup_animation: The hero phone mockup should gently float (y: [0, -10, 0]) on an infinite loop.

images.description: Woman using sign language, smiling. Use in the 'Why EaseTalk' bento grid to add a human element of accessibility.
Pastel blue/purple abstract gradient. Can be used as a low-opacity background image or masked inside a card.

icons.style: Use thin stroke-width (1.5) for a premium, lightweight feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over gradients meets APCA / WCAG standards. Deep slate on light gradients works best.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid on all major CTA buttons, form inputs, and navigation links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page scrolling application with distinct semantic <section> tags.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'. Add 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' to your fonts.

For the Hero Phone Mockup, you can build a CSS-based representation of a phone screen (rounded border, top notch, floating) containing a stylized chat or AI interface to represent 'EaseTalk'. You can also use one of the abstract backgrounds provided to fill it.
Implement the soft blue/purple highlights using Tailwind radial gradients or absolute div elements with blur-3xl and bg-blue-400/20 behind text.
In the 'Our 3 Smart Apps' section, name them: 'EaseTalk', 'EaseTalk Alert', and 'EaseTalk Learn' with respective icons.
In 'Emerging Innovation', highlight the phrase 'Powered by Emergent Agent AI' using a text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600.
Contact card should use a refined layout, removing bulky default inputs and replacing them with minimal customized Shadcn inputs (e.g. border-b only, or soft rounded inputs with zero shadow).
